description: Returns all pending and queued transactions (Supported only on Geth).

array.description: A list of pending and queued transactions, with each having the following fields:

array.pending.description: An array of transaction objects, with following fields:

array.pending.address.nonce.description: The nonce of the sending address

array.pending.address.nonce.blockHash.description: The hash of the block where this transaction was in, null here

array.pending.address.nonce.blockNumber.description: The block number where this transaction was added encoded as a hexadecimal, null here

array.pending.address.nonce.gas.description: The total amount of gas units used in the transaction

array.pending.address.nonce.gasPrice.description: The total amount in wei the sender is willing to pay for the transaction

array.pending.address.nonce.maxFeePerGas.description: The maximum amount of gas willing to be paid for the transaction

array.pending.address.nonce.maxPriorityF.description: The maximum amount of gas to be included as a tip to the miner

array.pending.address.nonce.nonce.description: The number of transactions the sender has sent till now

array.pending.address.nonce.to.description: The address of the receiver. null when its a contract creation transaction

array.pending.address.nonce.transactionI.description: An integer of the transactions index position in the block encoded as a hexadecimal format

array.pending.address.nonce.value.description: The value transferred in Wei encoded as a hexadecimal format

array.pending.address.nonce.type.description: A number between 0 and 0x7f, for a total of 128 possible transaction types

array.pending.address.nonce.accesslist.description: A list of addresses and storage keys that the transaction plans to access, introduced in EIP-2929

array.pending.address.nonce.chainId.description: It returns a hexadecimal value in string format which represents an integer of the chain ID

array.pending.address.nonce.v.description: The ECDSA recovery id encoded as a hexadecimal format

array.queued.description: An array of transaction objects, with following fields:

array.queued.address.nonce.description: The nonce of the sending address

array.queued.address.nonce.blockHash.description: The hash of the block where this transaction was in, null here

array.queued.address.nonce.blockNumber.description: The block number where this transaction was added encoded as a hexadecimal, null here

array.queued.address.nonce.gas.description: The total amount of gas units used in the transaction

array.queued.address.nonce.gasPrice.description: The total amount in wei the sender is willing to pay for the transaction

array.queued.address.nonce.maxFeePerGas.description: The maximum amount of gas willing to be paid for the transaction

array.queued.address.nonce.maxPriorityFe.description: The maximum amount of gas to be included as a tip to the miner

array.queued.address.nonce.nonce.description: The number of transactions the sender has sent till now

array.queued.address.nonce.to.description: The address of the receiver. null when its a contract creation transaction

array.queued.address.nonce.transactionIn.description: An integer of the transactions index position in the block encoded as a hexadecimal format

array.queued.address.nonce.value.description: The value transferred in Wei encoded as a hexadecimal format

array.queued.address.nonce.type.description: A number between 0 and 0x7f, for a total of 128 possible transaction types

array.queued.address.nonce.accesslist.description: A list of addresses and storage keys that the transaction plans to access, introduced in EIP-2929

array.queued.address.nonce.chainId.description: It returns a hexadecimal value in string format which represents an integer of the chain ID
